ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Sun and Saturn

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.

t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Start something new today, however small.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Spend five minutes in silence before going to sleep.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Write down a dream and three steps to get there.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Set aside an hour without interruptions for what matters most.

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Teach someone something you know well.
